SHIMMER GEORGETTE HIJAB

Our Shimmer georgette hijabs are made with georgette fabric with hints of shimmer lines in the hijabs. This easy to drape, lightweight fabric will be perfect for occasions or everyday wear. We bet you, this will be your perfect  go-to hijab for occasions which gives a subtle hint of shimmer and luxurious touch your outfit.


Fabric : 100% Polyester

Measurement : 200 x 75 CM (Approx.)

Fabric care : Hand wash/dry clean /machine wash on delicate with a light detergent on warm with only other scarves in like colors. Tumble dry on low. For stains, spot-treat with a delicate fabric stain remover.


While we try our best to ensure product colors shown are a true depiction of the actual product colors, we do not guarantee a true color match.

jsonld.description:
SHIMMER GEORGETTE HIJAB

Our Shimmer georgette hijabs are made with georgette fabric with hints of shimmer lines in the hijabs. This easy to drape, lightweight fabric will be perfect for occasions or everyday wear. We bet you, this will be your perfect  go-to hijab for occasions which gives a subtle hint of shimmer and luxurious touch your outfit.


Fabric : 100% Polyester

Measurement : 200 x 75 CM (Approx.)

Fabric care : Hand wash/dry clean /machine wash on delicate with a light detergent on warm with only other scarves in like colors. Tumble dry on low. For stains, spot-treat with a delicate fabric stain remover.


While we try our best to ensure product colors shown are a true depiction of the actual product colors, we do not guarantee a true color match.
